title: SendUnitData connected explicit request
purpose: Cover the connected CPF path and interaction between a connected address, sequence number, connected data item, and nested attribute path.

messages.label: SendUnitData with Connected Address and Connected Data items

expected_behavior: The server parses a SendUnitData payload with two CPF items, a four-byte connected address, a sequence number, and a nested explicit GetAttributeSingle-shaped request.
constraints_preserved: SendUnitData command is 0x0070 in a 24-byte encapsulation header
Encapsulation payload length is 34 bytes and matches the complete payload
CPF item order is Connected Address Item followed by Connected Data Item
Connected Address Item type is 0x0100 and Connected Data Item type is 0x00b1
Connected Data Item length includes the two-byte sequence number and nested data
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is enabled. The GetAttributeSingle service byte and EPATH target are conservative model-prior completion for a gap in the supplied excerpt, not an exact historical payload or vulnerability claim.
